name: Spell Specialization (3rd Party – Rogue Genius Games)
body:
You deal more damage with ray or energy missile spells.

Prerequisite: Weapon Focus (ray), Spellcaster level 4th+.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to all damage dealt by spells that require a touch attack.
